items.title: Buddy Burns and Frank Pasley Interview, 1968-09-23

ctx.x: Yeah. Did you have any other New Orleans musicians?
Oh, I played with Peter Williams. I played with Jack Carey. Jack Carey.

items.title: Buddy Burns Interview, 1958-08-14
items.q: The interviewee narrates the relationship between Jack Carey and Kid O'Re ('Jack Carey and Kid Oren used to buck all the time... both of them was good') but does not describe a personal interaction or relationship with Jack Carey himself.

ctx.x: Tell me some more about the parade, the brass bands uptown. Were they big organized bands or just little pick up groups?

Well, most, you see like Bebe Risley, he had an organized band and also Kid O'Re had an organized band. On the street through the march, you know, you mean? Yeah, well they paraded too, like you know on advertising and parade around. Yeah, they did all of that also. And Jack Carey, he had an organized band. That's a good trombone man. Mm-hmm.
Don't have any pieces that they use. And those.
